steps.title: Jade River
steps.sub: Lotus Ferry, the hour before dawn

steps.text: You're up! Good. The river muttered all night and kept me awake with it.
Here. Tea for the road. It's in your Bag, beside your hand.

steps.prompt: Your Bag holds her tea

steps.text: Your mother stood at that door every dawn, watching the water. You have her stubborn chin.
Lu wants you at the docks. Something about the river. Go on.

steps.prompt: Walk to the door: drag the stick

steps.text: Grey water by the reeds again. Third morning running.
Hush, Mei. Not where the little ones can hear.
My kite! The wind took it onto the inn roof!
Lu's at the docks, by the boats. Off you go.
Four errands, four corners of the village. Look.
Hah! Hup!
Any order you like. The river will keep until you're done.
Watch. Jab, cross, jab. The hip turns, the fist follows.
Your turn. Five on the stump.

steps.prompt: Punch the stump: tap Attack

steps.text: Elbow in! Good. Keep going.
Up the crates, onto the hall roof, then jump across to the inn!
It's the best kite in Lotus Ferry. Please hurry!
Race you to the watch-tower bell. Loser guts tomorrow's fish.
On three. One... two...

steps.prompt: Race him to the bell: push the stick all the way

steps.text: Too slow! Tomorrow's fish are yours to gut.
What?! ...Fine. Don't let it go to your head.
Now where did I put the willow bark...
Oh! My clumsy shelves. Hold still, child, you're scratched.
Take a tea from your Bag and put it where your hand finds it: Quick-use.

steps.prompt: Open your Bag: put Herbal Tea in Quick-use
Drink it: tap Quick-use

steps.text: Better. Now bow at the shrine in the square. It remembers those who visit.
The village is done with you. The shallows aren't.
Reed Shallows, just past the gate. Mind the claws.
Shoo! Get back in the river, the lot of you!
They came up out of the water in the night. Dozens!

steps.prompt: Drive off a crab: tap Attack

steps.text: Thank you! It dropped something. A gutting knife? Keep it.
Fish! Grey fish, jumping out of the river! They bite!
Child! Get us to your aunt's hut. Quickly now!
In here, all of you! The door's open and the lamp is lit!

steps.prompt: Strike the grey minnows: tap Attack

steps.text: Bring them to my door! The grey things shy from the lamp.
I'm going! Don't let them bite you!
Dou! In, in, by the stove. Who's next?
Bless you, child. There's a healing pill in your hand now: swallow it if that thing bites.
Granny Liu, lean on me. Go on, child, the others!
My stock can drown for all I care. I'm going, I'm going!
Ma! Mind the step. Inside with you!
That's all of them. Now you, child, get in here!
The lane! They're coming up both ends of it!
Too many of them? Come into my lamplight. They won't follow you here!
Heaven help us, look at it! Child, when it rears up, get out of its line!

steps.prompt: It rears before it lunges: step aside, then strike it on the bank

steps.text: Hit it while it's stranded, before it slides back!
It's only a beast, for all it's grey. It bleeds!
The river's boiling round it... it's growing!
Child, run! No blade can cut that thing now!

steps.prompt: Its hide turns every blow now: stay alive!

steps.text: Keep moving! Don't let it pin you!
No! Get away from the child!
Old legs, child. Not old hands.
Nine seals. Now it cannot dive.
Thousand-Catty Palm! That one's for my shop!
A lamp on the water... it's Lu!
Back to the dark, grey thing. This river is mine.
Up you get. A bruise or two. Nothing broken.
Granny? Old Ma? You... you fought that thing?
Every old dog in this village had a sect once.
What you saw was cultivation, child. Qi, drawn in and let out.
You held the bank with a blade and nothing more.
When it struck you, I felt your Qi stir. You have the gift.
Come to my boat. Tonight you begin to cultivate.
That thing in the water was a Hollowed eel. The grey is spreading.
You have a gift. I felt it last night. Sit. Breathe as I showed you.

steps.prompt: Meditate: tap Cultivate

steps.text: There. You felt the bones take it. Bone Forging: your first step.

steps.prompt: Talk to Lu

steps.text: Watch the water. Push, the way the river pushes the boat.
Flowing Palm. The sects are choosing disciples at Stoneford this spring. Go west.
My purse! Thief! Stop him!
Quick-Fingered Hou. He lives on the rooftops, that one.
Keep your purse close in Stoneford, newcomer.
Jade Sect! The sword that writes, the brush that cuts!
Cloud Sect! Why walk to the peak when you could fly there?
You came! Hear them both out, then choose. It's for life.
Welcome to the Jade Sect. Keep your wrist loose and your word firm.
Welcome to the Cloud Sect. We'll teach you to fall before we teach you to fly.
Then I'll see you at the top. Or beat you there.
Elder Hu's note? Then you're for the marsh. That's half a day on foot.
The sect's transfer array. The watch post at the marsh keeps its twin.
Stand in the ring and hold up your token. It answers disciples on the sect's errands.

steps.prompt: Step onto the array: tap Travel

steps.text: I felt the token hum from my peak. So the grey came up to meet you.
Five of them, and you still standing. Come, tell me, while it's fresh.

steps.prompt: Talk to Elder Hu

steps.text: Mei Qing's salve draws the grey out of a wound. Then it can be fought, and it will have to be.
It is coming down the river from somewhere. Keep Lu's token on you: it hums when the grey is near.
My peak's array knows your token now. The sect is yours to cross in a breath.
Elder Sung's note? Then you're for the marsh. That's half a day on foot.
The sect's transfer array. The watch post at the marsh keeps its twin.
Stand in the ring and hold up your token. It answers disciples on the sect's errands.

steps.prompt: Step onto the array: tap Travel

steps.text: I felt the token hum from my peak. So the grey came up to meet you.
Five of them, and you still standing. Come, tell me, while it's fresh.

steps.prompt: Talk to Elder Sung

steps.text: Mei Qing's salve draws the grey out of a wound. Then it can be fought, and it will have to be.
It is coming down the river from somewhere. Keep Lu's token on you: it hums when the grey is near.
My peak's array knows your token now. The sect is yours to cross in a breath.
(The River Token hums against your chest, the way it did on Lu's boat.)
(Grey shapes shoulder up out of the reeds where the patches were.)
The disciple back from the marsh! One round at the post before you climb?
Mind the wind-up. Every disciple on the posts telegraphs the big swing.
Win and the yard will know your name. Lose and you sweep it.

steps.prompt: Spar at the post, or walk on

steps.text: Three watchers came back from the marsh grey to the elbow.
Mei Qing's salve drew it out. But grey doesn't blow in from nowhere.
The old maps mark a shrine under the river at Deepwater Bend...
Drowned before either sect was founded. Hush. The new one's listening.
Going up to the elder? Wait, wait!
Take him my lotus root tea. He forgets to drink when he's thinking, and he's always thinking.

steps.prompt: Talk to Gardener Ji

steps.text: Back from the marsh already? Then a round at the post before you climb.
Or try the plum-blossom poles. Fall off and you sweep the court.
Mind the wind-up. Every disciple on the posts telegraphs the big swing.

steps.prompt: Spar at the post, or walk on

steps.text: Going up to the elder? Wait, wait!
Take him my lotus root tea. He forgets to drink when he's thinking, and he's always thinking.

steps.prompt: Talk to Gardener Ren

steps.text: Two watchers back from the marsh, grey to the elbow.
Mei Qing's salve drew it out. But grey doesn't rise out of reeds by itself.
The old maps mark a shrine under the river at Deepwater Bend...
Drowned before either sect was founded. Hush. The new one's listening.
